name: startupcheck-ai
description: StartUpCheck AI - Analyse de viabilite d'idees de business (client React + serveur Express + SQLite)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run install:all && npm run db:push
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVEUR,CLIENT -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
